title: Grade Analyzer & Curved GPA
problem: Write a function analyze_grades(scores, curve=0) that accepts a list of numeric test scores (0-100) and an optional curve bonus. Apply the curve (clamped to max 100), compute the curved class average rounded to 1 decimal place, and return a dictionary with keys: 'average', 'passing_count' (score >= 60), and 'letter_grades' (list of 'A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'F' matching 90, 80, 70, 60 boundaries). Empty list returns {'average': 0.0, 'passing_count': 0, 'letter_grades': []}.
